description: Clearance Critter helps shoppers find US retail clearance deals and browse its tracked-product catalog by keyword, department, merchant and budget. Inspect published price evidence, comparison baselines and last-observed price and stock information, then follow retailer links. Results come from a precomputed public catalog, not live retailer searches; prices and availability must be confirmed at the retailer. Some purchase links are affiliate links. No sign-in is required, and the app cannot buy, reserve products or create price alerts.

defaultPrompt: Find the best clearance deals under $50 returns 200 matches, ranked by price quality.
